en: The image shows a black-and-white or sepia-toned photograph of the Parthenon, an ancient Greek temple, with some rubble and columns visible in the foreground. The structure appears worn and partially ruined. There are texts in Greek and French, including 'ΠΑΡΘΕΝΩΝ' (Parthenon), 'Athènes' (Athens), and 'Le Parthénon' (The Parthenon). There is also a logo or stamp in Greek and a website watermark: www.elia.org.gr.
